name: Differentiable uncalibrated imaging optimization
aliases: Joint optimization of volume and measurement coordinates
Uncalibrated tomographic reconstruction via differentiable rendering
definition: Jointly optimizes volume reconstruction and measurement coordinates (angles/detectors) by minimizing an objective function using automatic differentiation, with representation choice (implicit NN or spline) dictating iteration counts and hyperparameters.
summary: Differentiable uncalibrated imaging optimization jointly refines volume geometry and measurement coordinates as trainable parameters, unlike methods assuming fixed camera poses.
